evaluation_path: The registered production backend, via recognize() -> accepted. Same preprocessing, per-class gates, NMS, cross-class suppression and plausibility checks as POST /api/panel/analyze. This is not the trainer's validator and the numbers will be lower than results.csv.

best_operating_point.rationale: conf=0.2 maximises f1 (0.6593) among 6 measured point(s), at precision 0.5171, recall 0.9094, 9.0583 false positives and 0.9667 false negatives per image. Across the sweep, recall runs 0.994 -> 0.909 and precision 0.451 -> 0.517 as conf goes 0.01 -> 0.2. Measured through the deployed inference path — same preprocessing, gates, NMS and thresholds the API uses — so it predicts served behaviour rather than trainer-reported behaviour.
best_operating_point.how_to_apply: Set the components backend params to decode_floor=0.2, unknown_floor=0.2 (POST /api/ai/models/components/params). For better results than a uniform threshold, run `cli tune` to fit a per-class threshold at this operating point.

acceptance.statement: Production-path mAP@50 0.5995 does NOT meet the 0.85 target (best across the sweep: 0.6337). This is the number that describes served behaviour, so the model is not acceptable for production regardless of what the trainer reported. Lowering the threshold further trades the shortfall for false positives rather than fixing it — the gap closes with more or better training data.
